# Plan: Use platform-standard directories instead of hardcoded ~/.bivvy

## Context

Bivvy hardcodes `dirs::home_dir().join(".bivvy")` for user config, templates, and project state. This violates platform conventions (XDG on Linux, `~/Library/` on macOS, `AppData` on Windows). Cache and data paths (feedback, sessions) already use proper `dirs` functions — the problem is isolated to config + state + templates.

## Approach: Centralized `paths` module with legacy fallback

Create a single `src/paths.rs` module that defines all Bivvy directory paths, with:
- Platform-correct defaults via `dirs` crate
- `BIVVY_HOME` env var override (points all paths to one dir, for backward compat)
- Legacy `~/.bivvy/` fallback: if new-location files don't exist but `~/.bivvy/` does, use the legacy path

### Directory mapping

| Purpose | Function | Linux | macOS | Windows |
|---------|----------|-------|-------|---------|
| User config | `dirs::config_dir()/bivvy/` | `~/.config/bivvy/` | `~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/` | `AppData\Roaming\bivvy\` |
| User data (state, index) | `dirs::data_local_dir()/bivvy/` | `~/.local/share/bivvy/` | `~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/` | `AppData\Local\bivvy\` |
| Cache (already correct) | `dirs::cache_dir()/bivvy/` | `~/.cache/bivvy/` | `~/Library/Caches/bivvy/` | `AppData\Local\bivvy\` |

## Files to create

### `src/paths.rs` (new)

Central module exposing:
